capabilities: Pair the vault with the Nooka Telegram bot using a one-time code
Fetch queued notes into a configurable vault folder on a schedule or on demand
Decrypt end-to-end encrypted notes with a locally held RSA key pair
Revoke or disconnect individual devices from the bot
extras: Notes are stored in Notion and only delivered to Obsidian through the bot's server queue; undelivered notes are deleted server-side after 7 days. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Some UI strings in the README are in Russian.
problem: Capturing notes and media from a Telegram chat means manual copy-paste; there is no built-in way to deliver bot messages straight into a vault folder.

relations.evidence: Save notes, voice messages and Instagram Reels from the Nooka Telegram bot straight into your vault.

summary: Inbox plugin that pulls notes, voice messages and Instagram Reels sent to the Nooka Telegram bot into your vault, end-to-end encrypted.
